name: NPC Low Stock Notice for WooCommerce
author: NPCoding LTD

sections.description:
Customers decide faster when they can see that stock is running out. NPC shows one short message on the product page, only while the real stock is at or below the level you set.

  • One level: set the stock count at or below which the message shows.
  • Your words: edit the message; {qty} becomes the number left.
  • Shows only for products that manage stock and are in stock; the number is the real one.
  • Works with high-performance order storage.
  • No external requests, no tracking, no account.

Trademarks

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Open WooCommerce > Low Stock Notice, set the level, and switch the notice on.
sections.faq:
Does it change stock or orders?

No. It only reads the stock quantity and prints a message.

Where does the message appear?

On the single product page, below the price. A site can change the level per product with the npc_lsn_threshold filter.

short_description: Show "Only 3 left in stock" on the product page when stock runs low, with your own wording and threshold.
